sentences.en: We can not dispense with sleep for too many days.
sentences.zh: 我们不能连续好几天不睡觉。

sentences.en: It seems unlikely that any society could completely dispense with myths.
sentences.zh: 似乎任何社会都不可能完全摒弃神话。

sentences.en: In doing this, we cannot dispense with his help.
sentences.zh: 做这件事，我们离不开他的帮助。
